surface.$description: Neutral elevation backgrounds — the grey container palette. Three levels: page → card → raised. surface-6 is NOT here (it is a fill/outline colour); use it as a background only for exceptions. Distinct from `bg` (the colored status/active tint washes).

page.$description: The page background — the darkest surface everything sits on.

card.$description: Cards, popups, drawers, modals — the first elevation above the page.

raised.$description: Sub elements raised above a card — filled inputs, secondary buttons, chips, filled counters.

overlay.$description: The scrim behind modals/drawers — the page colour at 50%.

disabled.$description: Disabled surface — same as a card; the disabled cue comes from faded text/icon, not a background shift.

fill.$description: Solid brand/status fills for buttons, toggles, active markers. Hover/pressed are the base fill with a darken (bright fills) or lighten (dark neutral) overlay — in the live product an alpha layer / alpha change; here they are pre-composited to the Pro theme so the docs bake a concrete value like everything else.

active.$description: Flat active fill — primary buttons, selected states, active markers.

activeGradient.$description: The active gradient — active-1 → active-2 at 90°. Primary buttons/outlines that opt into the gradient; also reused as the border on hover. Flat when active-1 = active-2 (as in Pro).

accent.$description: Solid accent fill — the secondary brand pop.

negativeHover.$description: negative + 12% darken overlay (hover on a destructive action).

neutral.$description: Neutral/secondary button fill — the raised surface.

neutralHover.$description: neutral + 12% lighten overlay (hover on a dark surface).

disabled.$description: Disabled fill — the raised surface; the disabled cue is faded text/icon.

bg.$description: Colored 12%-opacity tint washes — the pale status/active backgrounds behind chips, labels, selected rows. The colour counterpart to the neutral `surface` group, built on the sub-* opacity primitives so they inherit the theme's hues.

active.$description: Active tint — selected/active row or chip, freebet.

accent.$description: Accent tint — the live label background.

outline.$description: Border/hairline/outline colours. Two neutral weights (default = surface-4, strong = surface-6) plus the active/accent/status borders.

default.$description: Default hairline — soft dividers and rest-state borders.

strong.$description: Strong border — outline-button borders, lines, emphasized dividers, hover borders.

active.$description: Active border — focus rings, selected outlines, active-tab underline.

text.$description: Text colours. default/secondary are the two greys; contrast is dark text for a light/contrast surface; forActiveBg is text on an active-colored fill (dark or white depending on the theme's active brightness).

default.$description: Default body text — max contrast (white) on the dark surfaces.

secondary.$description: Secondary/muted text — captions, metadata, placeholders, disabled.

contrast.$description: Contrast text — dark text for the rare light/contrast surface.

forActiveBg.$description: Text on an active-colored fill. Pro's active is bright orange, so this is dark (surface-0); a dark-active theme flips it to white. A future text.forLabelBg will formalise the per-theme label case.

active.$description: Active text — links, active tab labels, active values.

positive.$description: Positive text — winnings, gains, positive odds movement.

negative.$description: Negative text — losses, errors, negative odds movement.

onFill.$description: Text on a dark solid fill (e.g. Tooltip). For text on the ACTIVE fill use text.forActiveBg.

icon.$description: Icon colours — mirrors `text`. default is contrast (white) for content icons; use icon.secondary for chrome/field icons.

secondary.$description: Secondary/chrome icons — field icons, close ×, info circles, disabled.

contrast.$description: Dark icon for a light/contrast surface.

onFill.$description: Icon on a dark solid fill.

forActiveBg.$description: Icon on an active-colored fill — dark on Pro's bright orange active (mirrors text.forActiveBg).

betStatus.$description: My-bets settlement statuses. win/loose/cashout reuse the editable positive/negative/warning; halfWin/halfLoose/refund/pending use the four file-only extra status hues (color-4..7). The coloured dots/labels on a bet row.

label.$description: Small inline labels on cards/rows. Some are colored tints (live/freebet), some solid status (postponed/reviewing), plus the score chip and the two counter states. A dedicated text.forLabelBg (deferred) will handle text ON these backgrounds.

score.$description: Score chip background — a sanctioned surface-6-as-background exception.

inactiveCounter.$description: Inactive counter background — a faint lighten wash.

activeCounter.$description: Active counter background — the active colour.

darken.$description: Translucent black overlays (built on the page colour) laid OVER an element to darken it — pressed states and the darker half of hover. In code an rgba layer / alpha change. Steps 2/4/6/8 = 12/24/50/80%.

lighten.$description: Translucent white overlays laid OVER an element to lighten it — hover on dark surfaces. In code an rgba layer / alpha change. Steps 2/4 = 12/24%.

2.$description: Lighten 12% — the default hover overlay on dark surfaces.

shadow.$description: Shadow colours — the same page-colour black steps as `darken`, used as box-shadow colours. (The composite shadow geometry lives in the `elevation` primitive.) Steps 2/4/6/8 = 12/24/50/80%.

additional.$description: One-off semantic roles that do not fit the groups above.

preloader.$description: Loading spinner/skeleton accent — the active colour.
